home: Pro Extinction is a movement to end forced existence and all suffering, for humans and animals alike. Read the manifesto and join us.
manifesto: The Pro Extinction manifesto: why extreme suffering is the core problem of life, and why a vast and painless extinction is the only full answer.
basic-faq: Short answers to common questions about Pro Extinction: what the movement works towards, where it stands on violence, and how to take part.
full-faq: Detailed answers to the hardest questions about extinctionism: is extinction possible, can technology solve suffering, and isn't life meaningful?
criticism-of-different-pro-life-ideologi: Why human rights, politics, democracy, antinatalism, veganism and other pro-life ideologies cannot end suffering, and what extinctionism says instead.
principles-of-the-movement: The principles of Pro Extinction: suffering-focused ethics, a clear definition of suffering, and the values that guide the movement.
suffering-in-detail: What suffering is and how far it reaches: the forms of extreme suffering that humans and animals go through every day, shown in detail.
cosmic-extinction: Life likely exists beyond Earth, and so does suffering. Why extinctionism has to think on a cosmic scale, and the evidence for cosmic life.
history: A short history of Pro Extinction: founded in 2024 and growing fast, with channels in many languages and protests on the streets.
join-us: Join Pro Extinction and help end suffering: social media content, translation, debates, protests and activism, with our WhatsApp and Discord groups.
social-media-channels: Follow Pro Extinction on social media. Our channels, sorted by platform and language, with updates, education and community talks.
contact: Contact Pro Extinction by email, WhatsApp or Discord. We answer questions about the movement, its ideas and how to take part.
donate: Support Pro Extinction with a donation. Every contribution helps us reach more people, run projects and build a movement to end suffering.
